jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://forwardpush.com/ Marketing Specialist Remote Worldwide · Full-Time · 8:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time · 90-Day Paid Trial to Start Required: 4+ years at a marketing agency (a company that serves multiple clients; in-house or freelance-only experience does not count) and fluent English (C1 or above). The Role: We are hiring a Marketing Specialist to work across both client and Forward Push marketing priorities, taking approved strategy, content, and direction and turning it into accurate, polished work that is executed correctly. That includes creating brand and web assets from approved direction. This is a hands-on, proactive role. Our AI agents and automations handle more of the repetitive work every month, so this role is not about copying and pasting or scheduling posts. You will run and quality-check our AI-assisted marketing workflows, keep us ahead of what is changing in marketing and AI, test new tools and models, and tell us what we should be doing differently. In your first few months you will also handle hands-on execution, such as publishing, onboarding, and QA. As we automate those tasks, your role grows toward strategy and ideas. We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to find the answer, test what you learn, document it, and know when a question is needed before moving forward. This is not an entry-level marketing position. We are looking for someone with enough experience to know what good marketing execution looks like and enough judgment to catch problems before they become rework. Most of all, we want someone who is frustrated that their knowledge is going to waste at their current job and who can’t see room to advance there. You can see how fast technology is changing marketing, and you want to be the person who puts it to work. What You'll Do Industry Intelligence & AI Testing Monitor industry news daily and flag updates that affect Forward Push or our clients, such as AI model releases, Google and algorithm changes, platform updates, and pricing changes. Test new AI models and tools against what we use today, such as comparing models on the same task or trying a new video or image tool, and document what worked, what did not, and what it cost. You will have room to experiment. Challenge the team with ideas. We want someone who says “did you hear about this?” before we do. Marketing Execution & Publishing Run our AI-assisted publishing workflows to schedule and publish client and Forward Push social media content across major platforms, including bulk scheduling in GoHighLevel. Publish YouTube, podcast, blog, and other approved content, then confirm formatting, links, images, titles, descriptions, and other details are correct. Perform final QA before and after publication so the right content, image, account, platform, and schedule are being used. Review images for quality and audience fit, and create graphics or AI-generated images when needed. Coordinate approved ad creative and copy with the team members responsible for managing paid campaigns on other platforms. Build and maintain branded image templates for each client (Meta, Google Business Profile, YouTube thumbnails, Shorts, press releases), then produce finished images from them. Format, finalize and publish press releases from approved copy, confirming images, links and distribution details are correct. Create and edit professional headshots from client photos, making sure the likeness is accurate and approved by the client. Write and enter meta titles and descriptions for new website pages and published content. Client Onboarding & Platform Setup Own assigned onboarding tasks, including Google Business Profile setup and optimization, social platform setup, YouTube configuration, and Google Drive organization. Research platform requirements and best practices when something is unfamiliar, then complete the work accurately or confirm questions with Operations before proceeding. Wr

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Who we are Employment Hero is on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone around the world. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into an all-in-one solution. Since launching in 2014, we’ve grown from startup to global scale, reaching a valuation of over $2 billion and building a presence across six countries, with even more growth ahead. We now serve over 350,000 SMEs, pay more than 3 million employees, and support a growing pool of job seekers finding their next role through our platform. The EH Way At Employment Hero, we’re proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way. • We are Mission First – Our Mission determines what we work on, where we invest, and where we focus. Every decision runs through a single filter: does this accelerate our Mission? • We are Remote First – we champion a remote environment with a preference for asynchronous communication and a high degree of autonomy • We are AI First – we are committed to using AI to accelerate our mission; AI is not just a tool, it’s a fundamental part of how we operate, innovate, and scale • We Live by Our Values – we role model our values 100% of the time • We Expect High Performance – we set a high standard and we’re not satisfied with being average. This role We’re looking for a highly capable, data-driven Performance Marketing Specialist to own and execute our multi-channel performance marketing program across Canada. This is a hands-on, generalist role where you will take full end-to-end ownership of campaigns spanning Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn), Paid Search (Google Ads), Affiliate Networks, and emerging paid media channels, from setup through to optimization, scaling, and reporting. Beyond platform execution, this role requires strong commercial acumen and technical analytics capabilities. You will connect ad platform performance with CRM and pipeline metrics, run structured experiments, leverage AI tools, and work cross-functionally with Content, Creative, Ops, and Sales to drive measurable lead generation and pipeline outcomes. This role is ideal for a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can get up to speed quickly, and is comfortable owning campaign performance end-to-end. Your key focus areas will be End-to-End Multi-Channel Campaign Ownership • Campaign Execution & Optimization: Set up, manage, and optimize paid campaigns hands-on across core platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn Ads) and secondary/emerging channels (e.g. Reddit, TikTok, Content Syndication). • Generalist Program Management: Manage overall campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget delivery, pacing, and creative rotation across search, social, and display/programmatic channels. • Affiliate & Partner Channel Management: In collaboration with Global, coordinate partner marketing programs (e.g. via PartnerStack), including partner communication, onboarding, tracking, QA, and lead flow integration. • Performance Targets: Deliver against key MQL, pipeline, and customer acquisition targets within defined efficiency metrics (e.g., CPL, CP-MQL, CAC and ARR). Performance Analytics, Insights & Optimization • Funnel Analytics: Connect ad platform performance with marketing automation (Marketo) and CRM data (Salesforce) to build a holistic view of downstream lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution. This is with support from the Global Marketing Analytics team under the Marketing Operations team to execute. • Reporting: Monitor daily/weekly pacing, and present clear, actionable performance reporting and strategic recommendations to stakeholders. • Testing & Problem Solving: Proactively flag performance fatigue, audience saturation, or delivery issues. Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across copy, landing pages, creative formats, and targeting strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Rigor • Creative & Content Alignment: Partner closely
